xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5239: Flywheel page: make every Needs-you item clickable, with real targets, link styling, and a visible jump

plan.title: Flywheel page: make every Needs-you item clickable, with real targets, link styling, and a visible jump
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The Flywheel page's Needs you block lists what the operator must do, but most rows lead nowhere. The jump button scrolls the embedded conversation column and the target is never highlighted, because FlywheelPage clears the target the moment the timeline scrolls and the flash only runs on the bookmark path; rows with no origin fall back to the newest tick. Issue ids are unstyled buttons, a bare cross-repo '#7' cannot be linked, and the tick format cannot carry a destination URL for items such as 'upload AAB'.
narratives.Proposal: An item may end with '<https://…>'. parseNeedsYouTarget() in packages/contracts splits label and target, and needsYouItemKey() keys by label so adding a target keeps first-raised identity. The status pane renders a targeted item as one link; issue, PR and item links share NEEDS_YOU_LINK_CLASS (underline, pointer, focus ring, monochrome). Qualified owner/repo#n links include a leading 'PR '. Rows with no firstRaisedMessageId lose the jump button. The jump (when no AskUserQuestion is pending) opens conv-flywheel in its Command Deck pane through App's pending conversation target and /conv route; MessagesTimeline flashes a handled target row for 3000 ms. The skill and docs/FLYWHEEL.md document the syntax; changelog.d/pan-5239.md records it; Playwright screenshots go in docs/screenshots/pan-5239/.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No new stored state, endpoint or schema field; the server keeps sending item text verbatim
- No change to the session-feed Needs-you rows (PAN-3276) or the header NeedsYouIndicator count
- No change to how resolveNeedsYouItems walks ticks beyond the key ignoring targets
- No change to the bookmark jump's 1600 ms flash
- No in-page (embedded column) jump on the Flywheel page
- No support for ';' inside target URLs or for non-http(s) targets
- No visible text label added to the jump button
- pan flywheel status keeps printing the raw needs-you line, URL targets included

autoDecisions.summary: 'Main conversation view' means conv-flywheel's own Command Deck pane (/conv/conv-flywheel), not the Flywheel page's embedded column
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue calls the embedded column 'the narrow side column' and the operator asked to be 'taken to' items; App already has a pending-conversation-target path that CommandDeck consumes on its /conv deep link.

autoDecisions.summary: Parse targets in packages/contracts and make needsYouItemKey ignore the target
autoDecisions.rationale: The key is shared by the server's first-raised walk and the frontend; keying by label means the loop can add a URL later without the item looking newly raised, and no schema field is needed.

autoDecisions.summary: A targeted item renders as one whole link; inner issue/PR refs are not segmented
autoDecisions.rationale: Avoids nesting interactive elements, the PAN-5217 class of accessibility bug.

autoDecisions.summary: Hide the jump button on rows without firstRaisedMessageId, as the issue requires, even though the button also reopens a pending question
autoDecisions.rationale: Pending questions stay reachable from the app-wide pending-input dialogs, Decisions panel and session feed (other requestReopen callers).

autoDecisions.summary: Target jumps flash for 3000 ms; the bookmark flash stays 1600 ms
autoDecisions.rationale: 'A few seconds' per the issue, without changing bookmark behavior or its existing tests.

autoDecisions.summary: Link style is underline + pointer + focus ring with monochrome text
autoDecisions.rationale: The pan-style-guide says action links are monochromatic; the issue accepts underline or link color.

autoDecisions.summary: Screenshots are committed under docs/screenshots/pan-5239/ and linked from the PR body
autoDecisions.rationale: .gitignore names docs/screenshots/<topic>/ as the home for screenshots; PAN-5191 linked committed PNGs with ?raw=true URLs.

metadata.sizeJustification: One operator-visible feature: a Needs-you row is only useful when its target parsing (contracts), link rendering and styling (flywheel components), jump navigation (App/AppRoutes/CommandDeck types) and the visible highlight (chat timeline) all ship together, plus the skill and docs that teach the loop the syntax. Each slice is small (22 files, mostly one-line type or test edits) and the DAG already serializes the shared files; splitting into sibling issues would ship rows that link but still jump invisibly, or a syntax the loop writes before the page can render it.
